notes: FY 2026-27 (AY 2027-28). Budget 2026 left slabs unchanged. New regime: 0/5/10/15/20/25/30% at 4/8/12/16/20/24 lakh, standard deduction ₹75,000, rebate (s.87A, now s.157 of the Income-tax Act 2025) up to ₹60,000 for taxable income ≤ ₹12 lakh with marginal relief. Old regime: 5/20/30% at 2.5/5/10 lakh, standard deduction ₹50,000, 80C up to ₹1.5 lakh, rebate ₹12,500 ≤ ₹5 lakh. Health & education cess 4%. Surcharge 10/15/25% (new regime cap 25%; old regime 37% above ₹5 crore). EPF employee 12% of basic; professional tax varies by state (₹2,400–2,500/yr typical).
